name: witness-alpha-controls
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.proof-witness.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; BAPA_SOURCE_ALPHA_CONTROL="$OUT/control" bun test research/bapa/proof-witness.test.ts research/bapa/source-projection.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/control"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/lean.log" BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/axioms.log" 2>&1; cp -a .lake "$OUT/control-bad-renaming/.lake"; cd "$OUT/control-bad-renaming"; set +e; lake env lean BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/bad-renaming.log" 2>&1; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -ne 0; grep -Eq 'BapaProof[.]lean:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: error:' "$OUT/bad-renaming.log"; cd "$ROOT"; printf '%s\n' 'feat(bapa): transport witness sources through checked alpha' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1; rm -rf "$OUT/control/.lake" "$OUT/control-bad-renaming/.lake"
